content: Pregnant individuals diagnosed with type 1 or type 2 diabetes should be prescribed low-dose aspirin, typically in the range of 100 to 150 mg per day, starting between 12 and 16 weeks of gestation. This intervention is aimed at reducing the risk of developing preeclampsia. A dosage of 162 mg per day may also be acceptable if available. Alternatively, if 162 mg or 100–150 mg doses are not accessible, 81 mg tablets can be used as an option.
